box-office.module.name: Box office
box-office.module.description: Selling tickets: what is on sale and for how much, seats held and sold, reservations paid for at the desk, orders, tickets and the door.
box-office.settings.baskets.hold-for.lab: Hold seats in a basket for
box-office.settings.baskets.hold-for.hel: How long seats are kept for a buyer once they press Hold tickets. Changing the basket does not restart it. A performance can have its own length.
box-office.settings.baskets.pay-within.h: How long seats are kept once the buyer goes on to pay. It starts afresh when payment starts, whatever was left on the basket.
box-office.settings.orders.seat-cap.labe: Most tickets in one online order
box-office.settings.orders.seat-cap.help: The most tickets one person can book online in a single order. A performance can have its own limit.
box-office.settings.sales.close-before.l: Close online sales before the start
box-office.settings.sales.close-before.h: How long before a performance starts online sales close. Nothing means they stay open until it starts. A performance can have its own closing time.
box-office.settings.checkout.payment-tim: When an online order is paid for

Whether tickets booked online are paid for at checkout, or reserved and paid for at the box office on arrival. With no online payment provider connected, tickets can only be reserved. A performance can have its own choice.
box-office.settings.reservations.confirm: Ask for a confirmed email address
A reservation keeps its seats only once the buyer has pressed the link sent to their email address. A buyer who is signed in is not asked.
box-office.settings.reservations.max-tic: The most tickets one reservation can hold.
Most reserved tickets for one person
The most reserved tickets one person may hold for one performance, across all their reservations.
box-office.settings.reservations.release: Release unclaimed reservations before the start
Reservations nobody has paid for are released this long before the performance starts, so the seats can be sold on the door. Nothing means staff release them by hand.
box-office.settings.cancellations.fee.he: Kept from each ticket when a cancellation is refunded less the fee. Nothing means the whole price goes back.
box-office.settings.orders.desk-seat-cap: Most tickets in one desk order
The most tickets a seller can put in one order at the desk, for group bookings.
box-office.settings.sales.desk-until-aft: Desk sells until this long after the start
How long after the performance starts the desk may still sell, for latecomers.
box-office.settings.retention.holds.labe: Keep the label of a staff hold for
box-office.settings.retention.holds.help: How long after the performance a hold placed by staff keeps its label, such as the name of the guests it was for.
Set up sales for a performance
box-office.abilities.performance.exceed-: Sell more than the space holds
box-office.abilities.order.view.label: See an order and its tickets
box-office.abilities.order.sell.label: Sell tickets at the desk
Take payment for a reservation, and change it first
box-office.desk.label: Tickets
box-office.abilities.order.cancel.label: Cancel tickets on an order, without refunding them
box-office.abilities.order.refund.label: Ask for a refund of an order's tickets
box-office.abilities.order.release.label: Release a reservation, or mark one to keep
box-office.abilities.ticket.admit.label: Scan and admit at the door
box-office.abilities.order.exchange.labe: Exchange tickets on an order for another performance or seats
box-office.abilities.report.view.label: See sales reports
box-office.abilities.report.export.label: Download sales reports
box-office.navigation.reports.label: Sales report
box-office.settings.comps.per-request.la: Most complimentary tickets in one request
box-office.settings.comps.per-request.he: Anyone asking for more makes a second request.
box-office.settings.comps.per-performanc: Most complimentary tickets for one performance
Approvals stop once a performance reaches this many. Nothing means no limit.
box-office.abilities.comp.request.label: Ask for complimentary tickets
box-office.abilities.comp.approve.label: Approve or decline complimentary tickets, never your own
box-office.navigation.comps.label: Complimentary tickets
box-office.settings.availability.show-re: Show seats left at or under
The booking button says how many seats are left only when there are this many or fewer. 0 never says.
